faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Toyger?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-15 lb (3-7 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Toyger?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) talks; Dental disease; Obesity. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Toyger at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Toyger, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
